title: Idempotence of the two actual Cech completion unit maps
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, O a sheaf of commutative rings, r a natural number (possibly zero), and b a Fin r-indexed list of global sections of O. Assume the unbounded derived category of O-module sheaves. Put L=RHom(C_b,-) with the actual augmented Cech complex and unit eta of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. For every derived object E, both L.map(eta_E) and eta_(L E) are isomorphisms. These assertions concern the specified maps rather than an unspecified isomorphism L(L(E)) ≅ L(E).

proof.text: 1. The term of Cech degree q is a finite sum of the flat localizations S_I at products over q-element subsets I, and the complex is bounded. For nonempty I choose j in I. In K tensor S_I, the j-th factor has invertible localization differential. Its inverse, multiplied on each tensor summand by (-1) to the sum of preceding degrees, contracts this complex: the other differential terms cancel in d h+h d. Cancel the identity ring-term pair in cone(epsilon). Filter the remaining positive Cech complex by Cech degree; its graded pieces are finite sums of shifted S_I with nonempty I. Tensoring with K makes each such graded piece contractible, hence the whole tensor cone acyclic. The tensor/mapping-cone comparison proves that the projection id_K tensor epsilon is a quasi-isomorphism, and symmetry proves the same for epsilon tensor id_K.

2. Bounded flatness makes K K-flat, so Hom(K,I) is K-injective for a K-injective representative I. Use evaluation at one and the fixed functorial replacement comparison in the definition of derived internal Hom to compute the actual units on representatives. Tensor-Hom currying identifies L(eta_E) with Hom of id_K tensor epsilon, and eta_(L E) with Hom of epsilon tensor id_K, after right and left ring-unit identifications respectively. The K-injective comparison maps intertwine these units by naturality of evaluation and precomposition. Hom into I inverts both projection quasi-isomorphisms, proving both actual maps invertible. Empty lists, zero or invertible generators, and zero rings obey the same formulas; no exactness of infinite products is used.

proof_origin.note: The two-projection tensor/Hom argument is the remaining analytic part; unit naturality and cancellation are proved separately in the consumer module.

theorem ringed_cech_completion_unit_idempotence (E : ringedSiteDerived O) :
    IsIso ((ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1).map
      (ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
        (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2 E)) ∧
    IsIso (ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
      (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2
      ((ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1).obj E))
